page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highcpu-64 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the n4d server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, as the GPU count is zero and local storage size is listed as none. Additionally, the instance does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high vCPU count relative to memory, the n4d-highcpu-64 offers a resource-dense profile designed for compute-bound workloads. This makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for tasks requiring significant parallel processing power without massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-heavy CI/CD pipelines.
